_PUBLICATION_FAILURE_STATUSES = frozenset({
    "RECOVERY_REQUIRED",
    "WRITER_BUSY",
    "CLAIM_BUSY",
    "REMOTE_MOVED_RETRYABLE",
    "BLOCKED_CONVERGENCE",
})


def classify_publication_diagnostic(
    result: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    job_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build a secret-free, fail-closed publication diagnostic from publisher output."""
    state = _clean(result.get("status")).upper() or "RECOVERY_REQUIRED"
    raw_reason = _clean(result.get("reason"))
    upper_reason = raw_reason.upper()
    safe_job_id = _clean(job_id or result.get("job_id"))
    if safe_job_id and not JOB_ID_RE.fullmatch(safe_job_id):
        safe_job_id = ""

    if any(
        marker in upper_reason
        for marker in (
            "COULD NOT READ USERNAME",
            "AUTHENTICATION FAILED",
            "TERMINAL PROMPTS DISABLED",
            "HTTP 401",
            "HTTP 403",
            "ACCESS DENIED",
            "CREDENTIAL",
        )
    ):
        category = "GIT_AUTH_FAILURE"
        error_code = "GIT_AUTH_FAILED"
        retryable = False
        recovery_required = True
        recommended_action = (
            "Verify non-interactive Git credential helper / per-URL useHttpPath config "
            "without modifying credentials, then recover the existing draft via gate_chain_publisher.submit()."
        )
    elif state == "BLOCKED_CONVERGENCE" or "CONVERGENCE" in upper_reason or "DIVERGENCE" in upper_reason:
        category = "CONVERGENCE_FAILURE"
        error_code = "BLOCKED_CONVERGENCE"
        retryable = False
        recovery_required = True
        recommended_action = (
            "Inspect GET /api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence and reconcile "
            "Development/Mirror before retrying."
        )
    elif state in {"WRITER_BUSY", "CLAIM_BUSY", "REMOTE_MOVED_RETRYABLE"}:
        category = "CONFLICT_OR_CONTENTION"
        error_code = state
        retryable = True
        recovery_required = False
        recommended_action = (
            "Check get_job_status for the existing job_id; if still unpublished, "
            "retry manually once writer/claim contention clears."
        )
    elif (
        "IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT" in upper_reason
        or "RESIDUAL_STATE_INCOMPLETE" in upper_reason
        or "QUEUE_PUBLISHER_RESIDUAL_" in upper_reason
        or "LOCK_BUSY" in upper_reason
    ):
        category = "CONFLICT_OR_CONTENTION"
        if "IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT" in upper_reason:
            error_code = "JOB_DRAFT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT"
        elif "RESIDUAL_STATE_INCOMPLETE" in upper_reason:
            error_code = "QUEUE_PUBLISHER_RESIDUAL_STATE_INCOMPLETE"
        elif "LOCK_BUSY" in upper_reason:
            error_code = "GIT_LOCK_BUSY"
        else:
            error_code = "QUEUE_PUBLISHER_RESIDUAL_CONFLICT"
        retryable = False
        recovery_required = True
        recommended_action = (
            "Do not duplicate the job; inspect existing draft/worktree state and "
            "recover the same job_id canonically."
        )
    else:
        category = "PUBLICATION_FAILURE"
        if "PUSH_FAILED" in upper_reason:
            error_code = "PUSH_FAILED"
        elif "AGENT_GUARD" in upper_reason:
            error_code = "AGENT_GUARD_WORKTREE_FAILED"
        elif "QUEUE_REMOTE_HEAD" in upper_reason:
            error_code = "QUEUE_REMOTE_HEAD_UNAVAILABLE"
        else:
            error_code = state if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,80}", state) else "RECOVERY_REQUIRED"
        retryable = False
        recovery_required = True
        recommended_action = (
            "Inspect GET /api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence and existing job_id "
            "draft state before recovering via gate_chain_publisher.submit()."
        )

    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-publication-diagnostic.v1",
        "category": category,
        "error_code": error_code,
        "status": state,
        "job_id": safe_job_id or None,
        "retryable": retryable,
        "recovery_required": recovery_required,
        "recommended_action": recommended_action,
        "production_touched": False,
    }


def _attach_publication_diagnostic(safe: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    state = _clean(safe.get("status")).upper()
    if state not in _PUBLICATION_FAILURE_STATUSES:
        return
    diag = classify_publication_diagnostic(safe, job_id=_clean(safe.get("job_id")))
    safe["publication_diagnostic"] = diag
    if "reason" in safe:
        safe["reason"] = diag["error_code"]

def _handle_readonly_status_error(
    status_code: int,
    response: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    error_code: str,
) -> None:
    if status_code in (401, 403):
        raise _extract_auth_error(
            status_code,
            response,
            "worker:status",
        )
    if status_code in (400, 409, 422):
        raise WorkerMcpValidationError(
            f"{error_code}_VALIDATION_FAILED",
            status_code=status_code,
            reason_code=_extract_validation_reason(response),
            payload=response,
        )
    if status_code == 503:
        reason_code, retryable = _extract_unavailable_reason(response)
        raise WorkerMcpUpstreamUnavailableError(
            f"{error_code}_UNAVAILABLE",
            status_code=503,
            reason_code=reason_code,
            retryable=retryable,
            payload=response,
        )
    raise WorkerMcpBackendError(
        f"{error_code}_FAILED",
        status_code=status_code,
        payload=response,
    )


def get_go_context(
    *,
    backend_url: str,
    token: str,
    domain: str,
    project: str = "EDARSAHUB",
    chain_id: str | None = None,
    objective_hint: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    internal_token = exchange_service_credential(
        backend_url=backend_url,
        credential=token,
    )
    query: dict[str, str] = {"domain": domain, "project": project or "EDARSAHUB"}
    if chain_id:
        query["chain_id"] = chain_id
    if objective_hint:
        query["objective_hint"] = objective_hint
    status_code, response = _request_json(
        method="GET",
        url=(
            backend_url.rstrip("/")
            + "/api/internal/worker/context?"
            + urllib.parse.urlencode(query)
        ),
        token=internal_token,
    )
    if status_code != 200:
        _handle_readonly_status_error(status_code, response, error_code="GO_CONTEXT_READ")
    return response

"""Contract tests for WK50 R2-B: 4 READ_ONLY MCP tools, R2-B.1 dynamic catalog, R2-B.2 diagnostics."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
if str(ROOT / "backend") not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))

from modules.worker_ingress import semantic_capabilities as caps
from modules.worker_ingress import service as ingress_service
from modules.worker_mcp import client as mcp_client
from modules.worker_mcp import server as mcp_server


EXPECTED_TOOLS = {
    "submit_objective",
    "get_job_status",
    "get_go_context",
    "list_capabilities",
    "preflight_objective",
    "get_runtime_convergence",
}


def _configure_server():
    mcp_server._BACKEND_URL = "https://hub.example.test"


def _mock_token(monkeypatch, scopes: list[str], token: str = "tok-r2b"):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        mcp_server,
        "get_access_token",
        lambda: SimpleNamespace(token=token, scopes=scopes, expires_at=None),
    )


def test_r2_b_tool_required_scopes_keep_least_privilege():
    assert set(mcp_server.TOOL_REQUIRED_SCOPES) == EXPECTED_TOOLS
    assert mcp_server.TOOL_REQUIRED_SCOPES["submit_objective"] == "worker:submit"
    for ro_tool in EXPECTED_TOOLS - {"submit_objective"}:
        assert mcp_server.TOOL_REQUIRED_SCOPES[ro_tool] == "worker:status"


def test_r2_b_four_new_readonly_tools_work_with_status_only_and_delegate_to_existing_endpoints(monkeypatch):
    _configure_server()
    _mock_token(monkeypatch, ["worker:status"])
    monkeypatch.setattr(mcp_client, "exchange_service_credential", lambda **kw: "internal-jwt")
    seen: list[tuple[str, str, dict | None]] = []

    def fake_request(*, method, url, token, payload=None, timeout=15.0):
        seen.append((method, url, dict(payload) if payload is not None else None))
        if "/api/internal/worker/context?" in url:
            return 200, {"schema": "edarsahub.worker-go-context.v1", "domain": "WORKER_MCP", "production_touched": False}
        if url.endswith("/api/internal/worker/capabilities"):
            return 200, {"schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-capabilities.v1", "capabilities": caps.capability_catalog(), "production_allowed": False}
        if url.endswith("/api/internal/worker/objectives/preflight"):
            return 200, {"schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-preflight.v1", "ok": True, "status": "PREFLIGHT_READY", "production_touched": False}
        if url.endswith("/api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence"):
            return 200, {"schema": "edarsahub.worker-runtime-convergence.v1", "overall_converged": True, "production_touched": False}
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected URL: {url}")

def test_r2_b_1_dynamic_capability_catalog_covers_contract_fields():
    catalog = caps.capability_catalog()
    assert len(catalog) == len(caps.registered_capabilities())
    by_code = {item["code"]: item for item in catalog}

    required_keys = {
        "code",
        "modes",
        "bounded_context_rule",
        "allowed_constraints",
        "allowed_path_roots",
        "bounded_context_path_ownership",
        "raw_worker_fields_forbidden",
        "required_fields",
        "required_constraints",
        "allowed_operations",
        "formats",
        "limits",
        "ownership",
        "safe_example",
    }
    for code, item in by_code.items():
        assert required_keys.issubset(item.keys()), f"Missing keys for {code}"
        assert item["raw_worker_fields_forbidden"] is True
        assert isinstance(item["safe_example"], dict)
        for forbidden in caps.RAW_WORKER_FIELDS_FORBIDDEN:
            assert forbidden not in item["safe_example"]

    dev = by_code["DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED"]
    assert dev["required_constraints"] == ["change_spec"]
    assert set(dev["allowed_operations"]) == set(caps._DEV_ALLOWED_OPERATIONS)
    assert dev["limits"]["max_changes"] == caps._DEV_MAX_CHANGES
    assert dev["limits"]["max_verification_tests"] == caps._DEV_MAX_TESTS
    assert dev["limits"]["max_text_bytes"] == caps._DEV_MAX_TEXT_BYTES
    assert dev["ownership"]["bounded_context_path_ownership"]["WORKER_MCP"] == [
        "tools/tests/test_worker_mcp_gate2b.py"
    ]
    assert "source_sha256" in dev["formats"]
